currentRelease.title: MonsterRPG Official 1.0 Release
currentRelease.summary: The premier release of MonsterRPG featuring dual-biome exploration (Oakdale Town and Whispering Woods), full building interiors with warp transitions, authentic overworld and battle monster sprites, partner follower system, turn-based elemental combat, and the legendary Mewtwo boss encounter.
highlights: Authentic Overworld & Battle Sprites integration with 64x64 front and back combat textures
Dynamic Partner Follower system with mood check and party synchronization
Full building interiors for Prof. Oak's Research Lab and the Oakdale Pokémon Center
Turn-based combat engine with elemental type effectiveness, dynamic lunges, and capture mechanics
Deterministic 16px grid-based movement with tap-to-turn and sprint mechanics
Legendary Guardian Boss showdown with Mewtwo in the hidden clearing

minimum.graphics: DirectX 11 / OpenGL 3.3 compatible GPU with 512 MB VRAM

features: Integrated authentic overworld single-frame sprites (16x16 and 32x32) from assets/overworld.
Integrated authentic front and back battle sprites (64x64) from assets/pokemon/.
Implemented FollowerPokemon system allowing your active partner monster to walk behind you.
Created full interior maps for Prof. Oak's Research Lab and the Oakdale Health Center.
Added interactive companion Pokémon in towns and interiors (Eevee, Meowth, Clefairy, Jigglypuff, Squirtle).
Added wild overworld encounters: Pikachu, Bulbasaur, Pidgey, Psyduck, Poliwag, and Snorlax.
Built turn-based combat system with elemental type affinities (Fire, Water, Grass, Electric, Psychic, Normal).
Implemented parabolic Capture Ball throw with platform wobble and starburst effects.
Added smooth screen fade-to-black warp transitions between exteriors and interiors.
improvements: Optimized Y-sorted sprite rendering for clean depth rendering of player, follower, NPCs, and props.
Smooth camera clamping around tile boundaries prevents out-of-bounds void visibility.
Refactored state machine to handle nested dialogues and seamless battle transitions.
Added interactive mood feedback when speaking with your partner Pokémon.
fixes: Fixed collision boundary where player could clip through solid interior counters.
Fixed state collision between dialogue dismiss and battle trigger.
Resolved texture coordinate distortion on 32x32 overworld boss entities.
knownIssues: Audio engine linking is complete; dynamic BGM and sound effect triggers are scheduled for Phase 1 of next milestone.
Manual game saving is currently persistent during session; persistent file serialization will arrive in v1.1.0.

features: Assembled 32x32 world tileset atlas featuring cobblestone, nature trails, fences, and foliage.
Implemented 44x28 dual-biome procedural map connecting Oakdale Town to Whispering Woods.
Added tall grass step detection with 18% wild encounter rate.
Introduced sprint mechanics (holding Shift for 120 px/sec run speed).
improvements: Refactored Character class hierarchy into distinct Player and NPC subclasses.
Added tap-to-turn system allowing directional changes without tile advancement.
fixes: Fixed diagonal movement slippage by strictly enforcing cardinal axis lock.
knownIssues: Building interiors not yet accessible (temporarily locked doors).

features: Engine bootstrap in C++20 with SFML 3.0.2.
TileMap rendering engine and 16px grid collision system.
Base Character animation state machine with 4-direction sprite sheets.
Initial prototype battle scene with static monsters.
